title: Universal Activation Verbalizer: A Unified Framework for Cross-Model Activation Explanation
abstract: arXiv:2605.25903v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Activation verbalization explains hidden representations in natural language, but existing methods are mostly limited to self-explanation, where each model explains only its own activations. We introduce Universal Activation Verbalizer (UAV), a framework that uses a shared decoder to explain activations from heterogeneous donor models. UAV learns a lightweight adapter that converts donor activations into soft tokens in decoder's embedding space, and further supports adapter-only transfer by reusing a frozen decoder-side LoRA while training only a new adapter for another donor. Across classification, fact retrieval, and gist summarization, UAV remains competitive with strong self-explanation baselines while enabling cross-model verbalization across model families and scales. translated_title: 通用激活言语化器：跨模型激活解释的统一框架
translated_abstract: 激活言语化旨在用自然语言解释模型中的隐藏表示，但现有方法大多局限于自我解释，即每个模型只能解释自己的激活。本文提出了通用激活言语化器（UAV），这是一个使用共享解码器来解释来自异构供体模型激活的框架。UAV学习一个轻量级适配器，将供体模型的激活转换为解码器嵌入空间中的软标记，并进一步支持仅适配器迁移——通过重用冻结的解码器侧LoRA，仅为另一个供体训练新的适配器。在分类、事实检索和主旨摘要等任务上，UAV与强大的自我解释基线相比仍保持竞争力，同时实现了跨模型家族和规模的跨模型言语化。消融实验表明，解码器侧的调优主要改善任务行为，而适配器则提供了基于激活的事实性和语义性信息。
tldr: 提出通用激活言语化器（UAV），通过轻量级适配器将异构供体模型的激活转换为共享解码器嵌入空间中的软标记，首次实现跨模型家族和规模的激活解释，并支持仅需训练新适配器的低成本迁移。
en_tdlr: UAV introduces a unified framework for cross-model activation verbalization, using lightweight adapters to map heterogeneous donor models' activations into a shared decoder's embedding space, enabling explanation across model families and scales with adapter-only transfer.
